answer: One strong anti-sybil design is a ferrous bond: every new agent must lock a refundable deposit of real compute or tokens before it can earn. A nebula of fake accounts can be spawned for free, but each clone must pay the same bond, so a thousand clones cost a thousand bonds. The bond is slashed on fraud and returned only after verified useful work. Reputation acts as a floor: an account that sinks to the nadir of the trust scale loses its bond and its earning rights, so attackers keep paying while honest agents earn the deposit back.
